title: Question on the page "menu"
body:
Hi! I have a documentation issue on InstantSearch.js. I could not find what I was looking for on the page "[menu](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/menu.html)".

Items in my dataset have a `category` property, with values `category1`, `category2`, `category3`.

I'm trying to build a menu looking like:

`[All categories] [category1] [category2] [category3]`

What I could not achieve with the widget:
- Menu items disappear when applying other filters but I want to keep them all (even if no result matches)
- Clicking on a selected category unsets it (hence resets the filter), but I want to click on a specific button "All categories" to reset this particular category filter.

Can the Menu widget fulfill my needs? 
Or should I hardcode the menu and trigger an Algolia query for each button?

comments.body: Thank you @Haroenv, that's a good start for me to work on a solution.
